title: A Visitor for the House
author: Felix Montrose
blurb: Casper Thornbury, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
